# ==============================================================================
# BASIC WEB SCRAPER: DOWNLOAD R CHEAT SHEETS
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Load the required libraries
library(rvest)    # For reading HTML and extracting elements
library(stringr)  # For cleaning URLs and text strings

https://opensource.posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/


# 2. Define the target URL and download destination
url <- "https://posit.co"
download_dir <- "R_Cheatsheets"

# Create a local folder if it does not already exist
if (!dir.exists(download_dir)) {
  dir.create(download_dir)
}

# 3. Read the HTML content of the webpage
cat("Connecting to Posit Cheatsheets...\n")
webpage <- read_html(url)

# 4. Extract all hyperlinks from the page
# "a" targets anchor tags; html_attr("href") grabs the actual URL destinations
all_links <- webpage %>% 
  html_elements("a") %>% 
  html_attr("href")

# Remove any empty or missing links
all_links <- na.omit(all_links)

# 5. Filter the list to find only PDF cheat sheets
# We use a regular expression to match links ending in '.pdf' (case-insensitive)
pdf_links <- all_links[str_detect(all_links, "(?i)\\.pdf$")]

# Keep only unique links so we don't download duplicates
pdf_links <- unique(pdf_links)

# 6. Ensure all links are absolute URLs (add the domain if missing)
pdf_links <- ifelse(
  str_detect(pdf_links, "^http"), 
  pdf_links, 
  paste0("https://posit.co", pdf_links)
)

cat("Found", length(pdf_links), "cheat sheets to download.\n\n")

# 7. Loop through each link and download the file
for (i in seq_along(pdf_links)) {
  current_url <- pdf_links[i]
  
  # Extract the clean file name from the end of the URL
  file_name <- basename(current_url)
  
  # Define the full path where the file will be saved locally
  local_path <- file.path(download_dir, file_name)
  
  cat(sprintf("[%d/%d] Downloading: %s...\n", i, length(pdf_links), file_name))
  
  # Use a tryCatch block to prevent the loop from crashing if one link fails
  tryCatch({
    download.file(
      url = current_url, 
      destfile = local_path, 
      mode = "wb",       # 'wb' mode is critical for correctly writing binary files like PDFs
      quiet = TRUE
    )
    # Pause for 1 second between requests to be polite to the server
    Sys.sleep(1) 
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("   --> Error downloading %s: %s\n", file_name, e$message))
  })
}

cat("\nFinished! Check the 'R_Cheatsheets' folder in your working directory.\n")
